Introduction

T.E.N (acronym for "Tremendous Energetic Novas") was a ten-member South Korean-Chinese project boy group under Narda Entertainment and Ideal Media Group. The group's lineup was composed of the five active RION FIVE members: Rohyoon, Minjae, Taewoo, Yousung, and Jeonghyeon, as well as five trainees: Simon, Yonghun, Liu Yang, Joss Cheng, and Han. They debuted on May 16, 2018, with the release of the single "Haeyo Haeyo".

Due to T.E.N's inactivity after this release, it is safe to say that the group eventually disbanded.
